inventory_rules: Freeze and audit every production file and function before its acceptance; planned paths may be refined only by explicit reviewed policy updates.
New production files must be classified, never silently excluded. Security classification follows behavior even when code moves.
Missing files, functions, counters or denominators fail the gate. Dead-code elimination does not establish coverage.
Mapping exceptions require raw evidence and supervisor review; thresholds must not be lowered after observing business-code failures.
Passing fuzz tests have no coverage traces; explicit deterministic outcome tests remain mandatory.
Type-only and generated dispatcher/test-helper attribution must be audited separately from production behavior.
